title: The Lost Route
description: Elara admits that she once marked an uncertain trail as safe. Help her rethink her maps.
completion_text: Elara can admit what she does not know and trusts you to help her plan safer routes.

stages.title: The Lost Route
stages.lead: Craft an empty map and discuss Elara's uncertain trail. Either objective can be completed first.
